<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed data'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining the root node -->
  <child ns2:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with some entities & internal markers <child>
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY nested "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %param;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?target data="processing instruction value"?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:x="http://xml.org/x">
  <!-- Comment 1: Testing nested entities and namespaces -->
  <section x:attr="val">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like string inside CDATA -->
      &nested;
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Value2">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY binaryFile "data.bin" NDATA bin>
  <!ENTITY % block "<!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA | comment)*>">
  %block;
  <!ELEMENT comment (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="print.css" media="print"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA section -->
  <file>
    <![CDATA[
      Archive entry CDATA content with entities &e1; &e2;
    ]]>
  </file>
  <file>&e1;</file>
</archive>

  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY val1 "TestOne">
  <!ENTITY val2 "&val1; TestTwo">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docPDF "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % pDecl "<!ATTLIST test id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %pDecl;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="theme.css"?>
<suite xmlns="http://example.org/suite" xmlns:tr="http://example.org/tr">
  <!-- Comment: Suite execution block -->
  <test id="t1" tr:status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Execution log: <test>&val2;</test> successful.
    ]]>
  </test>
  <test id="t2">&val2;</test>
</suite>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (chapter*)>
  <!ELEMENT chapter (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY chapEntity "ChapterEntityText">
  <!ENTITY % macroBlock "<!ELEMENT chapter (#PCDATA | footnote)*>">
  %macroBlock;
  <!ELEMENT footnote (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="layout.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:epub="http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops">
  <!-- Comment outlining chapter structure -->
  <chapter epub:type="chapter">
    <![CDATA[
      Chapter contents with special characters <>&'" and entity &chapEntity;
    ]]>
    <footnote>Note 1</footnote>
  </chapter>
</document>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task*)>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY tname "ProjectTask">
  <!ENTITY tdesc "&tname; Description">
  <!NOTATION zip SYSTEM "application/zip">
  <!ENTITY bundle "archive.zip" NDATA zip>
  <!ENTITY % attrMacro "<!ATTLIST task priority CDATA 'normal'>">
  %attrMacro;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.xsd" type="application/xml"?>
<project xmlns="http://example.org/proj" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment describing project tasks -->
  <task priority="high" meta:category="build">
    <![CDATA[
      Task CDATA payload with markup <task>&tdesc;</task>
    ]]>
  </task>
  <task>&tdesc;</task>
</project>

      Raw payload data containing &respEntity; and tags <payload>
    ]]>
    <error>None</error>
  </payload>
  <payload>&respEntity;</payload>
</response>
